requirementText: Procurement of 5 litre capacity stainless steel pressure cookers for commercial institutional canteens, constructed with AISI 304 food-grade stainless steel body and lid, equipped with metallic safety plug and gasket release system, conforming to IS 2347.
expectedEvidenceRequirements: Clause 8 Operating Pressure and Safety Release Test
notes: Clear verified baseline requirement for commercial pressure cookers with mandatory ISI certification under DPIIT QCO.
sourceReference: BIS IS 2347:2023 Gazetted Specification; DPIIT Quality Control Order S.O. 2294(E)
